correctness.rationale: Renewal formula accounts for reset as a full discrete step, killed-walk PGF follows from boundary equations, and the polynomial recurrence follows from a second-order differential identity. The first nonzero difference coefficient is exactly \(\mu(5\mu+5-m^2)/6\). Under nonnegative coefficient, the \(\alpha/\beta\ge4\) lemma is checked for all parity/b cases; coefficient-ratio comparison yields positivity for every higher degree, so no distant favorable reset exists. Exact rational independent hitting-equation solutions and coefficient tests passed. Finite checks supplement, not replace, proof for all parameters.

value.rationale: This solves a natural finite-cycle optimal-reset existence problem with a sharp integer phase diagram and equality case. The global coefficient-positivity certificate upgrades a one-sided local improvement test to a rigorous guarantee against beneficial high reset rates for any size and target distance. This is not a generic textbook substitution; the nontrivial all-coefficient comparison supplies the global structural conclusion. Scope is one-step nearest-neighbor cycle walks with one target.
